steps.description: Filter the TPM matrix to genes with TPM >= 1 in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size), then transform to log2(TPM+1) — this log transform is the only transform applied; no TMM, no size factors, no quantile normalization borrowed from count workflows. Build the design as ~0 + condition with the condition factor levels set explicitly so that control is the reference, and define the contrast as lesional minus control, so a positive log2FC means higher in lesional. Fit with lmFit and moderate with eBayes(trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE). Extract results with topTable(adjust.method = 'BH', number = Inf) and call genes differentially expressed at adjusted p < 0.05. In addition, run a treat() fit at lfc = 1 with topTreat to obtain the FDR-controlled set of genes whose effect exceeds a two-fold change — report that as a separate column/table rather than post-hoc filtering the eBayes table on logFC. Write out: the full results table (gene symbol, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, and the TREAT adjusted p), the number of genes tested after filtering, the number significant at FDR 0.05, the split into up- and down-regulated in lesional, a volcano plot, and a heatmap of the top 50 genes by adjusted p across the 12 samples.

plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control DE from TPM
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a gene-level TPM table from Salmon (12,000 genes x 12 samples; first column gene symbol) plus a 12-row metadata table with a condition column: 6 psoriasis lesional vs 6 control skin samples, unpaired, single batch. No raw counts and no quantification directories were delivered, so the negative-binomial count models (DESeq2, edgeR) and voom are not applicable — their variance models assume integer counts, and TPM values break that assumption (R-0004@a06d). The plan therefore runs limma on log2(TPM+1) with trend=TRUE and robust=TRUE, which is the sourced procedure for abundance input. T1S1 establishes sample structure on the log scale (PCA/MDS on the top 500 variable genes, sample-distance heatmap, detected genes per sample, colored by condition) so that any lesional/control separation, outlier, or unnamed processing structure is named before the model. T1S2 filters to genes at >= 1 TPM in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size), transforms to log2(TPM+1) with no count-style between-sample normalization, fits ~0 + condition with control as the explicit reference and the contrast lesional - control, moderates with eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE), and reports BH-adjusted results at FDR 0.05, with a TREAT fit at an absolute log2FC threshold of 1 as the effect-size-aware companion rather than a post-hoc fold-change filter. T1S3 writes the method, versions, design, thresholds, gene counts, and the reproducibility record. Scope is limited to the question asked — which genes differ — so no enrichment step is planned. The whole dataset is a 12,000 x 13 CSV, a few MB at most, so each step is small.
